info.title: Bug Bounty & Disclosure Platform API
info.description: REST API for a bug bounty platform: programs, report submission and triage, reward payouts, and Stripe-funded pools. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, message, data, meta? }` on success and `{ success: false, message, errors: [] }` on failure. Money is always an integer number of cents.

tags.description: Bug bounty programs and their reward tiers

tags.name: Admin

post.summary: Register a researcher or program owner account
Log in with email and password
Log in or register with a Google ID token
post.description: Verifies the ID token against `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`. Matches an existing account by Google ID, then by verified email; creates a new account otherwise.

401.description: Invalid Google token or unverified email

409.description: Email is linked to a different Google account

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Each refresh token works once. Reusing one that was already redeemed or logged out returns 401.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or already-used refresh token

patch.summary: Update the signed-in user's display name

post.description: Program owner only. A new program starts in DRAFT status.

get.description: Researchers and admins see ACTIVE programs by default; an owner adds `mine=true` to see their own programs at any status, including DRAFT. Admins see every status. The list is cached for 60 seconds per audience and filter combination; a hit sets `X-Cache: HIT`.
A non-ACTIVE program is visible only to its owner and admins; anyone else gets 404.

patch.summary: Update a program's title, description, or scope
patch.description: Owner only, and not while the program is CLOSED.

delete.description: Owner only. Refused while the pool holds funds or reports are still open.

409.description: Funded pool or open reports remain

put.summary: Set the reward amount per severity
put.description: Owner only, and not while the program is CLOSED. Replaces the amount for each severity listed; severities not listed are untouched.

patch.description: Owner only. Legal transitions: DRAFT→ACTIVE/CLOSED, ACTIVE→PAUSED/CLOSED, PAUSED→ACTIVE/CLOSED. CLOSED is terminal. Activating requires at least one reward tier.

409.description: Illegal transition, or no reward tiers set

post.description: Researcher only, and only against an ACTIVE program. Limited to 10 submissions per hour per researcher.

get.description: Researchers see their own reports, owners see reports on their programs, admins see every report.

patch.summary: Edit a report's title or description
patch.description: The reporting researcher only, and only while the report is NEW or NEEDS_INFO. Editing a NEEDS_INFO report moves it back to TRIAGING.

409.description: Report is not in an editable status

delete.description: The reporting researcher only, and only while the report is NEW or NEEDS_INFO.

409.description: Report is not in a withdrawable status

patch.description: Admin only. Legal transitions: NEW→TRIAGING/REJECTED/DUPLICATE, TRIAGING→ACCEPTED/NEEDS_INFO/REJECTED/DUPLICATE, NEEDS_INFO→TRIAGING. REWARDED is reached only through the reward endpoint. ACCEPTED requires a severity with a matching reward tier on the program. DUPLICATE requires `duplicateOfId`.

409.description: Illegal transition, missing reward tier, or invalid duplicate target

post.summary: Add a comment to a report
post.description: Open to anyone who can see the report: the reporting researcher, the program owner, or an admin.

post.summary: Pay the reward for an accepted report
post.description: Admin only. Debits the program pool, credits the researcher's wallet and reputation, and moves the report to REWARDED, all in one transaction. Safe under concurrency: a conditional pool decrement rejects an overdraw with `409 INSUFFICIENT_POOL`, and the unique `Payout.reportId` rejects a repeat with `409 ALREADY_REWARDED`.

409.description: Report is not ACCEPTED, already rewarded, no matching reward tier, or the pool cannot cover the amount

value.message: This report has already been rewarded
The program pool cannot cover this reward

get.description: Researchers see their own payouts, owners see payouts on their programs, admins see every payout.

post.summary: Start a Stripe Checkout session to fund a program's pool
post.description: Owner only, for a program they own that is not CLOSED. Returns a hosted Stripe URL to redirect the browser to.

502.description: Stripe is unavailable or returned no checkout URL

post.description: Called by Stripe, not by a client. Verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header against the raw request body. Idempotent: replays of the same event change nothing after the first successful delivery. Exempt from rate limiting.

get.description: Program owner or admin only. Owners see payments on their own programs; admins see all.

post.summary: Re-check a payment's status with Stripe
post.description: Covers a webhook that never arrived. Asks Stripe for the session state directly and applies it through the same idempotent path the webhook uses. A no-op if the payment is no longer PENDING.

get.description: Admin only. Every status change, role change, ban, and money movement is recorded.

422.description: Bad query, including from after to

patch.description: Refused on your own account, on a program owner who still owns programs, and when demoting or reassigning the last active admin.

409.description: Own account, owner still has programs, or last admin

patch.description: Refused on your own account and when banning the last active admin. Banning a program owner pauses their ACTIVE programs.

409.description: Own account, or last active admin

bearerAuth.description: Access token from register, login, or refresh-token.

NotFound.description: No such resource, or it is hidden from this caller

ValidationError.description: The body, params, or query failed validation

password.description: Must contain a letter and a number

role.description: Applies only when this creates a new account

UpdateProgramRequest.description: At least one field is required

tiers.description: Each severity may appear at most once

UpdateReportRequest.description: At least one field is required

duplicateOfId.description: Required when status is DUPLICATE, forbidden otherwise

pausedPrograms.description: ACTIVE programs paused by this ban, 0 for an unban or a no-op
